encode_samples_to_latent_distribution: encode input image samples into a FlaxDiagonalGaussianDistribution latent posterior using FlaxAutoencoderKL
decode_latents_to_images: decode latent representations back to image samples using FlaxAutoencoderKL decode method
run_full_autoencoder_pass: run a full encode-decode pass through FlaxAutoencoderKL with optional posterior sampling
sample_from_gaussian_distribution: sample latent vectors from a FlaxDiagonalGaussianDistribution using a JAX random key
initialize_autoencoder_weights: initialize FlaxAutoencoderKL model parameters by calling init_weights with a JAX random number generator
